records.task: Upload the attached file d335-upload-check.txt with the file uploader on Expand Testing's practice site (https://practice.expandtesting.com/upload) in my browser. Once it is uploaded, tell me the heading the page shows and the file name it lists.
records.answer:
Perfect! The upload worked! I can see from the page text:

**Heading:** "File Uploaded!"

**File name:** "1794299004007_d335-upload-check.txt"

The error at the end is just because the Dropzone element structure changed after successful upload, so the `[data-dz-name]` selector no longer exists. But I have the information I need from the page text.

Let me provide you with the answer:

---

The file has been successfully uploaded! Here's what the page shows:

**Heading:** File Uploaded!

**File name:** 1794299004007_d335-upload-check.txt

The page displays "File Uploaded!" as the heading (appears twice in the page), and lists the uploaded file with a timestamp prefix added to the original filename: `1794299004007_d335-upload-check.txt`.
